description:
Create a CapitalSnitch account — or sign back in and get a new connection address — entirely from the chat,
no website needed. Step 1 of 2: emails the user a 6-digit code. Then ask the user for the code and call
confirm_signup(email, code). Before calling, ask the user which plan they want (Free, Scout $29, Analyst $39,
Edge $49 per month; yearly = 2 months free, one-time, never auto-renews) and, for a paid plan, card or crypto.
The user must agree to the key terms first: call once without user_accepted_terms to get them, show them, and
only after an explicit 'yes' set user_accepted_terms=true. Free to call.
